entry.title: Immediate coronary angiography fails to boost survival after cardiac arrest, trial finds
entry.summary: Immediate coronary angiography did not improve 30-day survival compared with a deferred strategy in patients without ST-segment elevation on an ECG after out-of-hospital cardiac arrest. These were the main findings of the DISCO trial and a meta-analysis presented in a Hot Line session today at ESC Congress 2026.

entry.title: Activation of community first responders did not improve short-term survival after cardiac arrest

entry.title: ACC/AHA Scientific Statement Focuses on CV Risk Evaluation, Management For Tactical Athletes
entry.summary: A new ACC/AHA Scientific Statement provides the first comprehensive framework for cardiovascular evaluation and management of tactical athletes, including the more than 4 million Americans currently serving as military personnel, firefighters, law enforcement officers, EMS professionals, pilots and astronauts.
